description: This file defines an AssetManager class responsible for loading and managing icon assets in an Electron-based desktop application, including handling different themes and icon formats.

classes.name: AssetManager
classes.description: Provides static methods to load icons, retrieve application icons, and generate icons based on theme and format.

methods.name: loadIcons
methods.description: Asynchronously loads ICO icons from resource files into memory.

methods.name: appIcon
methods.description: Returns the path to the application icon based on requested format and size.

methods.name: icon
methods.description: Returns a native image or path for a specified icon name, theme, size, and format.
